blocks.text: Photosynthesis mein roshni (light) ki tawanai istemal hoti hai: photosynthetic pigments (rang dene wale madde) roshni jazb (absorb) kar ke use chemical tawanai mein badalte hain. Podon mein photosynthesis ko mukhtasar taur par yun likhte hain:

Carbon dioxide, pani aur roshni reactants (shuru ki cheezein) hain, jabke glucose aur oxygen products (banne wali cheezein) hain. Pani equation ke dono taraf is liye hai ke kuch reactions mein pani istemal hota hai aur kuch mein banta hai. Lekin aakhir mein pani ki koi khalis (net) paidawar nahin hoti.

blocks.title: Yaad karein
blocks.text: Photosynthesis woh amal hai jis mein carbon ka kam tawanai wala inorganic compound (CO₂) reduce ho kar zyada tawanai wale carbohydrates banata hai.

blocks.title: Compensation point
blocks.text: Photosynthesis respiration ke products (CO₂ aur pani) istemal karti hai aur respiration photosynthesis ke products (glucose aur O₂). Photosynthesis sirf din mein hoti hai, magar respiration din raat chalti hai. Andhere mein patte aur doosre hisse respiration karte hain, oxygen lete aur carbon dioxide chhorte hain. Subah aur shaam, jab roshni kam hoti hai, photosynthesis aur respiration ki raftar thori der ke liye barabar ho sakti hai: photosynthesis se nikli oxygen bilkul utni hoti hai jitni respiration ko chahiye, aur respiration se nikli CO₂ bilkul utni jitni photosynthesis ko chahiye. Us waqt patton aur hawa ke darmiyan gases ka koi khalis tabadla (net exchange) nahin hota; isi ko compensation point kehte hain. Dopahar ko roshni tez hone se photosynthesis bhi tez ho jati hai aur zyada CO₂ chahiye hoti hai jo akeli respiration nahin de sakti; aur photosynthesis ki oxygen respiration ki zaroorat se zyada hoti hai. Natija: patte oxygen bahar chhorte aur CO₂ andar lete hain.
